title: xgboost-rs param bench
_comment_machine_shape: T4 (SM 7.5). This kernel only runs xgboost_rs's own binary, whose CubeCL kernels NVRTC-compile for whatever device is present, so a P100 would work too — but the T4 is what docs/gpu-benchmarks.md was measured on, and comparing the two tables means using the same card.
